title: Clay for the kiln
Clay from the river bank
summary: The brick kiln of {settlement} has burned the last of its clay. Dig {count} × {item} for the {place}.
{settlement} needs {count} × {item} for the bricks of its {place}.
offer: The kiln is hot and the moulds are empty. {count} × {item} from the river bank, and the {place} will have its bricks.
Clay — good, sticky clay. {count} × {item}. The banks downstream are thick with it.
progress: The kiln is cooling while we wait.
complete: Lovely and fat. It will fire well.
That will make a good many bricks. Thank you.
